violation_type.title: Exceeding Maximum Group Size - 5 Yrs and Older (1 1/2 hr) (26 TAC §744.1609(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Exceeding Maximum Group Size - 5 Yrs and Older (1 1/2 hr)
violation_type.typical_finding: During the inspection I observed 89  children in one room not separated by barriers  for approximately 2 hours and 35 minutes.

finding_variants.text: During the inspection I observed 89  children in one room not separated by barriers  for approximately 2 hours and 35 minutes.

During the inspection, it was observed that a group consisting of 47 children was present and being supervised by one caregiver and one site director. However, the maximum permissible group size and the maximum number of children that 2 caregivers may supervise is 35 children.
